# Wait <Badge type="info" text="class" />

<p class="api-meta">Namespace <code>Lustral</code> · Assembly <code>Lustral.Api</code></p>

A condition that a coroutine waits for: `yield return Wait.Seconds(1)`.

```csharp
public sealed class Wait
```

## Properties

### FixedUpdate {#fixedupdate}

```csharp
public static Wait FixedUpdate { get; }
```

The next physics step (`FixedUpdate`), as Unity's `WaitForFixedUpdate`.

### LateUpdate {#lateupdate}

```csharp
public static Wait LateUpdate { get; }
```

After the game's `LateUpdate` methods in the current frame, or in the next frame if they have already run.

### NextFrame {#nextframe}

```csharp
public static Wait NextFrame { get; }
```

The next frame, after the game's `Update` methods. Equivalent to `yield return null`.

## Methods

### Frames(int) {#frames}

```csharp
public static Wait Frames(int frames);
```

The specified number of frames; 1 is the next frame.

### RealSeconds(double) {#realseconds}

```csharp
public static Wait RealSeconds(double seconds);
```

The specified duration in real time, regardless of the game's time scale, as Unity's `WaitForSecondsRealtime`.

### Seconds(double) {#seconds}

```csharp
public static Wait Seconds(double seconds);
```

The specified duration in game time, as Unity's `WaitForSeconds`: it is affected by the game's time scale and does not elapse while the game is paused. In game builds where Lustral cannot read Unity's time, real time is used.

### Until(Func&lt;bool&gt;) {#until}

```csharp
public static Wait Until(Func<bool> condition);
```

Until the condition is true. The condition is checked immediately, then once per frame after `Update`.

### While(Func&lt;bool&gt;) {#while}

```csharp
public static Wait While(Func<bool> condition);
```

While the condition is true. The condition is checked immediately, then once per frame after `Update`.
